description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Grant opportunities from the public Grants.gov feed, posted and forecasted federal grant postings, refreshed from the keyless Grants.gov API. Filter by keyword, agency, or deadline. Returns opportunity number, title, agency, status, close date, and assistance listing numbers as recorded. Present as information only; do not frame results as an eligibility determination or application recommendation. Verify every fact against the official grant posting before acting. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
